# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.js` is vendored from qrcode-generator 1.4.4, published on the npm registry.

Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase. Licensed under the MIT license. The original source header is preserved.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/1.4.4
Package SHA-1: 63f771224854759329a99048806a53ed278740e7

The package was obtained using npm pack with standard registry integrity and TLS verification. No third-party QR web service is used; the participant URL is encoded locally in the browser. No extra build/install step is required on Render.
